Hi Alice / Jamal — copying Dev. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) SCIM custom attributes: we support custom attributes on user objects via extension properties. I'll attach a short technical note describing the extension pattern and examples. We don't currently support SCIM schema filters beyond basic search; for very large orgs we recommend an incremental provisioning approach (we can share best practices).

2) Group provisioning: supported. Group membership is translated into the groups array on the user resource and we include delta sync endpoints to minimize load.

3) SAML metadata & assertion mapping: redwood_sso_saml_config.pdf (attached) includes the metadata XML and example attribute mappings for email, givenName, familyName, and directory roles. If you need a signed metadata blob for your IdP, Dev can generate one.

- sample_saml_metadata.xml (IdP/SP metadata example)

Key technical notes:
- Custom attributes: implemented using the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:redwood:2.0:User extension. Example attribute: urn:redwood:departmentCode.
- Provisioning behavior: we support incremental delta syncs and full-syncs; rate limits are 100 reqs/min for bulk endpoints (can be increased via Dedicated agreements).
- RBAC: admin-roles-matrix.csv (attached earlier) maps roles to allowed actions; highest-privilege roles are limited to named accounts and require 2FA + SSO enforced.

Delivery method for SOC 2: Marissa — I recommend a password-protected .zip or upload to the secure shared Drive link (we can set view-only and IP restrictions). Once you confirm, we'll drop the unredacted report there for Acme's eyes only.
